card.line: The Valley of Jehoshaphat is the place where God says He will gather all the nations to judge them for how they treated His people Israel.

moments.title: God gathers the nations
moments.text: God says that when He restores Judah and Jerusalem, He will bring all the nations down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There He will judge them for scattering His people and dividing up His land.

moments.title: God sits to judge
moments.text: The nations are called to advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, where God will sit down to judge them all. Crowds fill the valley of decision, for the Day of the LORD is near.
